items.title: AMD just spent $8.2 billion to enlist the 'Godmother of AI'
items.summary: In spending $8.2 billion to scoop up World Labs, AMD CEO Lisa Su has gained the "Godmother of AI" and possible successor for when the time comes.

items.title: AMD to buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs in $8.2 billion bet on 'physical AI'
items.summary: Sept 28 () - Advanced Micro Devices said on Monday it would acquire Fei-Fei Li's AI startup, World Labs, in ‌an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion, a move that ‌would give the chipmaker a foothold in research on physical AI systems that can ​understand and simulate the world.
